info.subtitle: Canada · Mexico · United States

steps.1text: The admin will create your account. Sign in with your credentials and choose the name you want to appear in the standings.
steps.2title: Fill in your group stage predictions
steps.2text: Before 11 June at 00:00 (CET) predict the result of all 72 group stage matches and your special picks (champion, runner-up, MVP, top scorer).
steps.3text: Predict all fixtures from the round of 16 to the final before 28 June at 15:00 (CET). The winners you pick advance automatically.
steps.4text: Before 24 July at 20:30 (Oslo time) pick the 8 teams you think will go through as best third-place teams. 0.5 points for each correct pick!
steps.5title: Follow the standings in real time
steps.5text: Points are calculated automatically. Check the standings and your rivals' predictions at any time!

info.payIntro: To take part you need to pay the entry fee. You can pay via Revolut or Vipps. Add your name as a reference.
info.vippsNote: Enter 100 NOK manually when paying with Vipps
